children: Applied Materials is increasing its investment in BE Semiconductor Industries to about 20% of the company's shares.

The semiconductor-equipment maker said Monday it has entered into an accelerated share purchase agreement for the shares. The share purchase would add to Applied Materials' existing April 2025 investment in BE Semiconductor Industries, also known as Besi.
The companies' collaboration began in 2020, and was recently expanded with Besi joining Applied Materials' EPIC Center as an innovation partner.
The share purchase builds on its investment in the semiconductor industry's AI-driven scaling roadmap, Applied Materials said.
